findings.title: Withholding tests guardianship
findings.claim: The withheld measure turns the brothers' promise to guard their brother into a condition-tested claim of custody.
findings.mechanism: The focus combines passive withholding, measured provision, and an emphatic guarding pledge; the surrounding trust question, renewed measure, and later protection language make access to provision expose whether the claimed guardianship can bear the condition.
findings.reader_payoff: The complaint about grain becomes a pressure point on the reliability of the people offering protection, while the ordinary request for measure remains intact.
findings.containment: This is a pericope-local relation between provision and claimed custody. It does not establish that the brothers knowingly planned the later outcome or that human guardianship is thereby invalidated.

epistemic.reason: The reviewed channel records and exact focus/context carriers support the relation, while the channel nomination remains a contextual interpretation rather than a grammatical fact.
